q: How do I set it as my wallpaper?
a: Open the app and tap Set as wallpaper, then confirm on your home screen. Then open Styles and pick a dashboard and its layout. Setting the wallpaper has every step.

q: How does the GPS speedometer work?
a: Switch the big gauge to GPS speed and allow your precise location. It shows your speed in km/h or mph, and a red mark keeps the top speed of the drive. Your location is used only for the speed, only while the wallpaper is on screen, and never leaves your phone.

q: How do I switch what the big gauge shows?
a: Tap the gauge on your home screen, pick the mode in the style's settings, or add the Big gauge tile to Quick Settings, which switches it on every phone, Samsung's included. It shows power, CPU clock or GPS speed.

q: Why does the CPU clock not move on my phone?
a: Some phones don't let apps read how fast the processor runs, so the CPU clock mode has nothing to show there. Power and GPS speed work on every phone.

q: Will I keep the styles I bought on a new phone?
a: Yes. On a new phone with the same Google account, the styles you bought come back by themselves.

q: What does the app read, and where does it go?
a: Nothing the gauges read is sent anywhere. Battery, memory, signal and Wi-Fi are read on the phone, and Future's music, missed calls and messages only with the notification access you give it. The privacy policy has the details.
